name: SculptForge
summary: Free, open-source digital sculpting app pitched as a ZBrush alternative, native on Linux, macOS and Windows. ZBrush-style brushes, symmetry and navigation, LOD generation, blend shapes, Send to Unreal, Gaussian splats and OpenUSD, plus built-in AI brush creator and image/text-to-3D with no account (or bring Claude, fal.ai, Meshy or local models).

access.notes: GPL-3.0: you can use it commercially and sell your sculpts; modified redistributions of the app must stay GPL. Optional third-party AI providers have their own terms.

procedure: Open the latest release page on GitHub
Download the build for your OS (Windows .exe/.zip, macOS universal .dmg, Linux AppImage/flatpak/deb/rpm/tar.gz)
Install and launch; no account needed. Guide at https://sculptforge.app/guide/

stats.cadence: Frequent releases; repo created 2026-10-21, ~313 GitHub stars

verdict.why: Real cross-platform sculpting app with active releases and a clear GPL license; strong fit for 3D/game artists. Young project (10 days old), so maturity vs ZBrush is unproven.
